  "title": "Internal Control Officer",
  "description": "Berger Paints Nigeria Plc - The company has a reputation for being the first in setting standards in the paint industry in Nigeria, evidenced by its scorecard as presented. It has pioneered a wide range of speciality products that are much sought after in this dynamic and ever-changing market. Berger Paints Nigeria PLC is also the first company to unveil an ultramodern fully automated factory with a daily capacity of 10,000,000 litres of paint production.

Operating in 5 business segments Decorative/Architectural finishes, Industrial coatings, Marine &amp; Protection coatings, Automotive/Vehicle refinishes, Wood Finishing and Preservers, with a manufacturing plant and main distribution centre in Lagos, over 25 depots/business partners&rsquo; outlets, Colour World centres and a countrywide distribution network of dealers in strategic locations spread throughout the country, the most notable contribution to our success has been the Company&rsquo;s on-going commitment to the development and manufacture of paints and allied coatings which are technologically correct, environmentally friendly and formulated to withstand harsh tropical conditions.

In 2012, Berger Paints Nigeria Plc. entered into a partnership arrangement with the biggest heavy-duty coating manufacturing company in South Korea, KCC Corporation to jointly serve the Nigerian paint and coating market. This partnership affords our customers the quality and durability that marine and protective market have found synonymous with the KCC marine and heavy-duty brands.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Internal Control Officer&nbsp;

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Implements control processes to minimize risk and theft. Drafts control processes and makes recommendations for improvement.
	Works with all departments to ensure potential risk and controls are being implemented appropriately.


Job Functions
Inventory Management &amp; Control:


	Perform periodic and surprise checks on raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, packaging materials and other inventories to ensure their existence, accuracy and proper safeguarding.
	Monitor inventory movements and verify that receipts, issues, transfers and dispatches are properly authorised, documented and accurately recorded in the Tally system.
	Participate in periodic stock counts and independently reconcile physical inventory with system records.
	Investigate inventory variances, damages, losses and unusual movements and prepare reports for the Internal Control Manager.
	Monitor controls designed to minimise inventory losses, theft, pilferage, wastage and unauthorised movements.
	Verify the accuracy of supporting documents for finished goods dispatched from the warehouse, including sales invoices and delivery notes.
	Review and monitor controls over rejected, damaged, obsolete and slow-moving inventory.


Raw Materials, Packaging Materials &amp; Production Controls:


	Perform control checks over the receipt of raw materials, packaging materials and other production inputs to ensure that quantities received agree with approved purchase orders, goods received notes and other relevant documentation.
	Verify that raw materials have undergone the required Quality Assurance testing and approval before being released for production, in accordance with established procedures.
	Monitor the process for the rejection, return and disposal of non-conforming raw materials to ensure appropriate documentation and authorisation.
	Perform periodic checks over the movement and consumption of raw materials in the production process.
	Monitor compliance with approved material requisition, issuance and production reporting procedures.
	Review and report unusual material consumption, wastage and production variances.
	Conduct control checks to ensure that finished goods produced are properly recorded and transferred to the warehouse.


Process &amp; Internal Control Review:


	Assist the Internal Control Manager in conducting periodic reviews of operational, financial and administrative processes to identify control gaps, process inefficiencies and potential risks.
	Perform periodic control testing and document the results, exceptions and report same to the Internal Control Manager.
	Assist the Internal Control Manager in the design and implementation of appropriate controls, taking into consideration operational risks and business requirements.
	Follow up on agreed management action plans and monitor the implementation of corrective actions arising from control reviews and internal audits in operations


Compliance &amp; Risk:


	Escalate significant control failures, suspected fraud, theft, losses or other irregularities through the appropriate reporting channels.
	Support the implementation of risk mitigation measures and monitor their effectiveness.


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: Recruitment@bergerpaintnig.com using &quot;Internal Control Officer&quot; as the subject of the mail.",

	Perform control checks over the receipt of raw materials, packaging materials and other production inputs to ensure that quantities received agree with approved purchase orders, goods received notes and other relevant documentation.

        Smart Nuel Communications Limited is a growing mobile technology retail company headquartered in Ikeja Computer Village, Lagos, one of Nigeria’s largest technology markets. The company specializes in the sales and distribution of mobile phones and related accessories across major cities in the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Sales Representative 

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	This role is responsible for processing daily sales transactions, issuing invoices, maintaining accurate shelf stock records, and providing excellent customer service.
	The role also involves administrative support duties, daily reporting, and ensuring a clean and organized work environment while supporting the branch manager with assigned responsibilities.


Responsibilities


	Receive sales orders from customers, accurately entering them into the system daily.
	Prepare and issue sales invoices promptly and accurately.
	Ensure proper documentation of all sales transactions.
	Conduct stock counts and submit accurate stock reports twice a week.
	Monitor stock levels and report shortages or discrepancies to management.
	Prepare and submit weekly and monthly sales reports.
	Maintain accurate records of sales, inventory, and customer transactions.
	Receive and attend to customer phone calls and complaints professionally.
	Provide customer support and forward complaints or issues to the manager when necessary.
	Maintain positive relationships with customers through courteous and efficient service.
	Ensure cleanliness and organization of the office environment.
	Carry out any other responsibilities assigned by the branch manager.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess an OND, HND, or Bachelor's Degree with 1-2 years of experience.


Salary
N90,000 - N100,000 Monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position and Location as the subject of the email. eg: "Sales Representative-Portharcourt".

	ZEZ Nigeria Limited is seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Executive to join our team.

Senior Procurement Executive Job at ZEZ Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        ZEZ Nigeria Limited is an indigenous company established to bring solutions to the Oil and Gas, Marine, Manufacturing and Energy Industries in Nigeria. We provide high quality solutions and services to the energy sector throughout Nigeria. ZNL along with its partners, offers world-class solutions and continuously adds value to the business and operations of her diverse clients.
     

            
    



We have a qualified, highly motivated, and professional work force that are well equipped to deliver excellent services to our clients. ZNL conducts its business with utmost standard of ethics and pride in delivering value added services with the aim of maintaining trust, respect and integrity with our clients, employees and suppliers. Our goal is to become the “One-stop shop” for oil and gas field support in Procurement and HSSE consultancy.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

Job Position: Senior Procurement Executive

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	ZEZ Nigeria Limited is seeking an experienced Senior Procurement Executive to join our team.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience in procurement and supplier management, with the ability to support project requirements while delivering quality, cost-effective, and timely sourcing solutions.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage end-to-end procurement activities, including sourcing, RFQs, evaluation, negotiations, and purchase orders.
	Source materials, equipment, and services in line with project specifications, timelines, and budgets.
	Develop and manage relationships with suppliers, vendors, and contractors.
	Monitor supplier performance, quality, cost, delivery, and compliance.
	Conduct market research to identify competitive suppliers and cost-saving opportunities.
	Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements.
	Prepare procurement reports, spend analyses, and maintain accurate procurement documentation.
	Collaborate with project, technical, and Business Development teams to support project execution and bids.
	Provide guidance and mentorship to junior procurement team members.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in procurement/sourcing.
	Experience in the Energy, Oil & Gas industry is preferred.
	Strong knowledge of sourcing, supplier management, negotiation, and procurement processes.
	Excellent analytical, communication, negotiation, and organizational skills.
	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
	Professional procurement certification (e.g., CIPS) is an added advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Operations - Logistics Specialist III Job at ABNL Limited




        
    

        
        ABNL Limited was incorporated in 1992 as an Oil and Gas servicing company with a vision to provide professional engineering and technical services to the Oil and Gas exploration and production companies in Nigeria and the West African sub-region. Since its incorporation, the company has grown in leaps and bounds, expanding its business horizon, but still within the Oil and Gas sector.
     

            
    



ABNL is a 100% owned indigenous firm, with a shareholding in excess of 100 million Naira. Its' directors are individuals of proven integrity, who over the years have acquired the requisite experience in the Oil and Gas business, as well as in the banking and finance sector. The integrity of the directors and the staff of the company have been a priceless contributive factor in the growth and wellbeing of the company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below: 

 Job Position: Operations - Logistics Specialist III

Job Location: Seplat House, Lagos
Employment Type: Contract

Main Functions


	Logistics Specialist provides subject matter expertise to operating teams. Expert resource for Logistics and may include aviation, marine, shore base, ground transportation and camp services to deliver safe reliable and cost efficient logistic services. Demonstrates good planning, scheduling, coordination and administration skills and able to influence without authority at all levels within an organization. Logistics Specialist may cover some or all of the responsibilities listed below.


Tasks and Responsibilities
In addition to all Level 1 and 2 tasks and responsibilities, Level 3:


	Works with Aviation and Procurement to optimize both helicopter and fixed wing transportation.
	Ensures all logistical support activities follow proper company process and control.
	Provides expertise for remote, onshore and offshore logistics including marine support commissioning, material transfer and start up procedures.
	Participates in emergency preparedness doctrine, training and drills.
	Provides more technical/functional support than administrative support.
	Makes decisions within broad parameters.


Skills and Qualifications


	BSc Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or other Technical degree
	Demonstrates excellent communication and interpersonal skills; able to network effectively across organizations.
	Demonstrates a thorough working knowledge of technology, applications, terminology, and procedures required of job function.
	Behavioral Skills: adaptability, analytical capability, applied learning, effective communication, sound decision-making
	Functional Skills: Safety, Security, Health, and Environment (SSHE) management - operations and maintenance, managing critical operations, operations - specific technology and unit or area, maintenance management, logistics, general marine operations


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV in MS Word to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
